data.name: Hillel
data.gender_notes: Hillel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Hebrew hā-lēl, meaning 'praise God'. Hillel was an ancient Jewish sage and a leading figure of the Pharisees in the late Second Temple Period. He is known for his teachings on ethics and his wise counsel to prospective converts to Judaism. The name Hillel carries the meaning “Praise God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Hillel usually hope their child will grow to embody praise god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encouragement and guidance to seek God's wisdom and live a virtuous life.
data.etymology: Hillel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Praise God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hillel total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: הלל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: הלל (Hillel) - שם ישראלי שמשמעותו 'אדיר, מכובד, נבון, יליד, יוצא'. בן השם הוא 'ישעיה' ( Isaiah 8:1 ) שמציווה את בנו 'אחיקם' ( Ahikam ) 'להלל' ( לקראתך ).

in_greek.name: Ἱλεήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ἱλεήλ (Hillel) - ὀνόματι Εβραϊκῶν, ἀπὸ τοῦ Ἑβραϊκοῦ ἕλεη = εὐλογητός. Σημαίνει τοὺς εὐχαριστούς, τὴν εὐχαριστίαν, τὴν αἴτησιν, τὴν ὑπακοή. Σημαίνει τοὺς εὐσεβεῖς, τοὺς εὐσεβεῖν.

in_latin.name: Hillel
in_latin.long_meaning: Hillel - nomen Iudaeorum, significat gloriosus, honoratus, sapientia, nativus, exitus. Significat eos qui laudent, qui gratias agunt, qui petunt, qui obedientes sunt. Significat eos qui pietate sunt, qui pietate vivunt.

in_english.name: Hillel
in_english.long_meaning: Hillel - a Hebrew name meaning 'praiseworthy, honored, wise, born, exitus.' It signifies the praise, gratitude, prayer, obedience, and piety of those who bear it. In the Hebrew Bible, Hillel is the name of a prophet (Isaiah 8:1) who commands his son Ahikam to 'hillel' or 'praise' God. In Christian tradition, Hillel is associated with humility, wisdom, and a strong faith.

pronunciation.biblical: Hebrew pronunciation: hillel, Greek pronunciation: ee-le-el
